title: fix(plugin-grid): a named import mapping names fields by their labels, and its preview survives a second file
body:
Part of #34939

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

This PR carries the UI half of the card, parts (2) and (3). Part (1), a translation-bundle group for import mappings, needs a spec change and follows in its own PR. Until then the card stays open.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 导入向导里，已保存映射的「映射到」列改为显示字段的服务端标签（中文组织即中文名），不再显示 API 名；选中已保存映射后返回上一步重新上传文件，预览按该映射重新取列，不再变成空表。
- **为什么改：** zh-CN 组织里映射步骤只看到 `supply_week` 这类英文 API 名；重新上传后预览列被自动匹配覆盖，与服务端实际执行的映射不一致，表头与单元格全空，而导入本身照常成功，用户看到的预览是假的。
- **风险与回滚：** 只改 `@object-ui/plugin-grid` 的两处纯前端逻辑，请求体不变（仍只发 `mappingName`）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看：** `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx` 的 `handleFileLoaded`（有已选映射时改用映射推导预览列）与 `SavedMappingSummary`（字段标签解析）；`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/savedMapping.ts` 的 `summarizeSavedMapping`。
- **两分钟验证：** `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.preselectOnlyMapping-13343.test.tsx`，预期 9/9 通过，其中两条新用例分别断言「映射到」列显示 `公司` / `线索来源`，以及重新上传后预览单元格为 `Globex` / `Partner`。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

Both changes are in `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, in the import wizard, when a saved (named) import mapping is active:

- **The mapping step's summary names targets by their field labels.** `SavedMappingSummary` showed each target by its API name. It now resolves each name against the wizard's own `fields`, which carry the labels the server serves (translated in a localized organization), the way every other wizard screen already names a field. `summarizeSavedMapping` takes an optional label resolver, and a split entry's targets are resolved one by one. A target the wizard has no field for keeps its name, because there is no label to show.
- **Loading a second file keeps the preview on the named mapping.** After Back plus a new file, the mapping stayed selected and the import still named it, but `handleFileLoaded` auto-matched the new headers against the field names. That is a mapping the server never applies. With headers unlike the field names, the preview had no columns. `handleFileLoaded` now derives the preview columns from the active mapping (`savedMappingToDisplayIndexMap`), as picking the mapping does, and auto-maps only when no named mapping is active.

The request the wizard sends is unchanged: source rows plus `mappingName`.

## Tests

- `ImportWizard.preselectOnlyMapping-13343.test.tsx` (the saved-mapping harness) gains a top-level describe with two pins:
  - the summary names each target by its served label (`公司`, `线索来源`) and shows no API name;
  - Back plus a second file under the mapping previews the mapped values (`Globex`, `Partner`).
- `ImportWizard.savedMappingEmptyValue-8504.test.tsx`: the summary testable now receives `fields={[]}`, the prop the component now requires.
- Ablation, one leg per fix, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1/1; restore proven as blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`). Reverting `handleFileLoaded` to the auto-map reds the reload pin only (1 failed, 8 passed). Removing the label resolver reds the summary pin only (1 failed, 8 passed).

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured live in zh-CN before the fix** (showcase backend plus this branch's Console Vite, Chromium with locale zh-CN; zh-CN field labels added temporarily for the reading and since removed):
  - the summary's Maps To column read `name`, `email`, `company`, `message`, `source`, while the preview headers for the same fields read the translated labels;
  - a single pass with the shipped mapping previewed every value;
  - after Back plus a file whose headers do not resemble the field names, the preview showed only the row-number column, and the import button still read 导入 2 行.
  - The reload path is the only one found that blanks a named mapping's preview. Whether it is the reporter's path is inferred, not confirmed.
- **Not in this PR: the mapping's own label** (`Inquiry feed (marketing CSV)` stays English in zh-CN). `GET /meta/mapping` is not translated because `mapping` has no translator and the bundle has no group for it. That is part (1) of the card, routed separately.
- **Probably the same stale-state shape, measured from code only:** a local mapping template stays selected in the template bar after Back plus a new file, while the new file is auto-mapped. It was not reproduced live, so it is noted here and not changed.
